name: 80045 · Aurora, CO
findings: ZIP 80045 (Aurora) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80045 (Aurora) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
